stories.title: Joel Kaplan leaves Meta
stories.take: Meta's longtime policy chief is out — a late, major shake-up in who runs trust, safety and election policy at the company.

stories.title: SpaceX and Tesla boards form special committees to review merger
stories.take: Both boards have formed special committees to review a merger, and Musk is publicly backing the idea — the Tesla-SpaceX tie-up is now a formal process, not a rumor.

stories.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
stories.take: Anthropic is pitching a safety bill that could block a model release if it could plausibly kill 50 or more people — the lab is asking to be regulated on its own terms.

stories.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
stories.take: OpenAI bought Orchestra Bio to beef up its biotech business — the AI race keeps expanding from chatbots into the lab.

stories.title: Google is bringing a more personal version of its Gemini AI assistant to your car
stories.take: Google is bringing a more personal Gemini to cars, using what it knows about you to make the in-car assistant actually useful.

stories.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
stories.take: The US has ordered federal agencies to remove China's DeepSeek from their systems — the model is now formally treated as a security risk.

stories.title: Salesforce to Buy Braze for $5.66 Billion
stories.take: Salesforce will buy Braze for $5.66 billion — customer engagement just became core CRM, and the martech consolidation wave rolls on.

stories.title: Netflix Lowers Expected Ad Revenue After Slower Rollout of Capabilities
stories.take: Netflix lowered its expected ad revenue after a slower rollout of its ad capabilities — the streaming ad business is taking longer to mature than pitched.

stories.title: FTC Approves Publicis’ $2.2 Billion LiveRamp Deal With ‘Neutrality’ Conditions
stories.take: The FTC approved Publicis' $2.2 billion LiveRamp deal, but only with 'neutrality' conditions — data access is the price of closing.

stories.title: Apple finally explains its Safari block, and identity companies are in its sights
stories.take: Apple finally explained its Safari block, and identity companies are in its sights — another privacy move that also strengthens Apple's own ads business.

stories.title: Charli XCX Joins Absolut for ‘Chaotic’ Two-Year Partnership
stories.take: Charli XCX joins Absolut for a 'chaotic' two-year partnership — the brand is buying Brat-era cultural energy outright.

stories.title: Robert Downey Jr. Trades Tony Stark’s Aviators for Snap’s AR Specs
stories.take: Robert Downey Jr. traded Tony Stark's aviators for Snap's AR Specs — Snap landed a Marvel-sized face for its glasses push.

stories.title: Sixers rally in LeBron's debut, spoiling Knicks' championship celebration
stories.take: Final: the Sixers rallied in LeBron's Philly debut to spoil the Knicks' championship celebration at MSG — opening night delivered.

stories.title: Pistons pull off 22-point comeback vs. Celtics, NBA's largest on first day of season
stories.take: Final: Detroit erased a 22-point deficit to beat Boston, the NBA's largest opening-day comeback — the young Pistons announced themselves.

stories.title: George's 38 most by Celtic in debut, but comes in loss: 'I'm not a moral victory guy'
stories.take: Paul George scored 38, the most by a Celtic in a debut, and Boston still lost — 'I'm not a moral victory guy,' he said.

stories.title: Dybantsa debut delayed: No. 1 pick out opener due to ankle
stories.take: No. 1 pick AJ Dybantsa will miss Washington's opener with an ankle injury — the most anticipated debut of the season is on hold.

stories.title: Karl-Anthony Towns confirms he's willing to take less money from Knicks amid halted contract extension talks
stories.take: KAT says he's willing to take less money from the Knicks as extension talks sit halted — a rare star discount offer, with the cap math still unresolved.

stories.title: Warriors' Podziemski (back) surprise scratch vs. Lakers
stories.take: Brandin Podziemski was a surprise scratch against the Lakers with back soreness — Golden State started opening night already shorthanded.

stories.title: Rays will face Brewers in World Series to produce a first-time champion
stories.take: It's set: Rays vs. Brewers in the World Series, which guarantees a first-time champion either way.

stories.title: The World Series matchup is set! How Rays, Brewers can win it all
stories.take: First look at the Fall Classic: how Tampa Bay and Milwaukee each win it — small-market baseball owns October this year.

stories.title: 'Fastball Freddy' Peralta named ALCS MVP after pitching Rays into World Series
stories.take: 'Fastball Freddy' Peralta was named ALCS MVP after pitching the Rays into the World Series, including the Game 6 clincher.

stories.title: Boone returning as Yankees manager in 2027, source says
stories.take: Aaron Boone will return as Yankees manager in 2027 — New York is sticking with its skipper for a 10th season despite another October exit.

stories.title: MLB qualifying offer for free agents rises to $23.15M, up 5.1% from 2025
stories.take: The MLB qualifying offer rises to $23.15 million, up 5.1% from 2025 — the price of draft-pick compensation keeps climbing.

stories.title: Japanese slugger Sato, 27, seeking to join MLB team through posting system
stories.take: Japanese slugger Teruaki Sato, 27, will seek an MLB move through the posting system — the next big international bat is officially on the market.

stories.title: Michael Bloomberg spends $80m on Democrats as Trump moves $400m to Republican candidates
stories.take: Bloomberg is spending $80 million on Democrats while Trump moves $400 million to Republican candidates — the midterm money war is fully on.

stories.title: DoJ’s suspected non-citizens list includes ‘high percentage’ of those born in US, LA officials say
stories.take: LA officials say the DOJ's suspected non-citizen voter list includes a 'high percentage' of people born in the US — the list's accuracy is now the story.

stories.title: How the Kansas Senate race became surprisingly competitive
stories.take: How did Kansas become a competitive Senate race? A Democrat's 'fight like hell' pitch in a state that was supposed to be safe.

stories.title: WATCH: Trump doesn't commit to endorsing Vance for president in 2028 yet
stories.take: Trump declined to commit to endorsing Vance for president in 2028 yet — the succession question stays deliberately open.

stories.title: Nigeria confirms Ebola case in its capital as woman who arrived from Uganda tests positive
stories.take: Nigeria confirmed an Ebola case in Abuja, in a woman who arrived from Uganda — the outbreak has now spread into western Africa.

stories.title: Florida puts 77-year-old man to death, carrying out its 18th execution of the year
stories.take: Florida executed a 77-year-old man, its 18th execution of the year — the state's record pace continues.

stories.title: ‘Borders on the absurd.’ California fights Trump lawsuit to set aside 20,000 ballots
stories.take: 'Borders on the absurd': California is fighting a Trump lawsuit to set aside 20,000 ballots, in the state's central election fight of the fall.

stories.title: Storms descend on Southern California, raising risk of dangerous surf, flooding, debris flows
stories.take: Storms have descended on Southern California, raising the risk of dangerous surf, flooding and debris flows — a wet, hazardous night ahead.

stories.title: Feds hold back an additional $1.2 billion in California Medicaid reimbursements
stories.take: The feds are holding back another $1.2 billion in California Medicaid reimbursements — the state-federal funding fight keeps escalating.

stories.title: California state workers are about to strike. What that means for the DMV, EDD, parks and more
stories.take: California state workers are about to strike — here's what that means for the DMV, EDD, parks and other services residents actually use.

stories.title: Thousands of California voters got duplicate vote-by-mail ballots. Here's what happened
stories.take: Thousands of California voters got duplicate vote-by-mail ballots — election officials explained what happened and what voters should do.

stories.title: After their 13-year-old died in an e-motorcycle collision, they're facing charges
stories.take: After their 13-year-old died in an e-motorcycle collision, his parents are facing charges — a case that will test where parental liability begins.

stories.title: Are Americans’ Finances Better or Worse Under Trump?
stories.take: The answer is mixed, category by category: groceries cost a family of four ~$15/week more, mortgage rates hit 7.4% and auto loans are up ~$3,000 • But the S&P 500 is up 30% since pre-inauguration and 401(k)/IRA balances are up ~18.3% • Holiday airfare is surging: Thanksgiving tickets +31% year over year, Christmas +23%

stories.title: Elon Musk Ordered Last Week’s Starlink Slowdown
stories.take: WSJ reports Musk personally ordered a speed cap on Starlink in Ukraine that left offensive and interceptor drones virtually useless • Accounts conflict: Musk said speeds were 'up to Trump,' Trump said he didn't know, and a source says Musk consulted senior officials first • SpaceX earnings also landed: Q3 revenue more than doubled to $14.6B on AI growth

stories.title: Pushback On Trump's Russia Policy, Competitive Midterm Races, DOJ Noncitizen Voting
stories.take: Trump lifted Russian diesel sanctions, paused a sanctions bill and paused intel sharing with Ukraine — and Ukraine lost Starlink connectivity for days • Zelenskyy briefed a bipartisan congressional group, saying he believes the US was behind the outage • Also: competitive midterm races tighten, and the DOJ's noncitizen voting push draws scrutiny

stories.title: Israelis have changed. Will they change their leader?
stories.take: The answer: it's too close to call — polls put Eisenkot's camp slightly ahead, but neither he nor Netanyahu has a clear path to a majority • The race could hinge on a handful of votes or end in stalemate and a repeat election next spring • If Netanyahu loses, Eisenkot promises an Oct. 7 inquiry and a settler-violence crackdown, but no near-term Gaza or Lebanon withdrawal and no two-state support

stories.title: Trump Midterm Campaigning, Rep. Omar Home Searched, Europe Pushes Back on Russia Deal
stories.take: Trump's midterm rallies are vintage Trump: he tells crowds to 'pretend that I'm on the ballot' while the actual candidates barely speak • Protesters interrupted twice in Youngstown; one was roughed up before removal • Also covered: the search of Rep. Omar's home and Europe pushing back on the Russia deal

stories.title: James Talarico on the Rage Economy, Billionaires and Flipping Texas
stories.take: Democrat James Talarico leads Ken Paxton in Texas Senate polls in a state Trump won by 14 — Republicans have spent ~$200M on attack ads against him • His frame: politics is top vs. bottom (billionaires vs. working people), and a 'rage economy' profits from outrage • His agenda: suspend the federal gas tax, ban corporate PACs and congressional stock trading, raise the minimum wage and tax billionaires • NYT polling shows 9% of Republicans and 11% of Trump voters already favor him

stories.title: Elizabeth Holmes and Nathan Fielder Keep Us Guessing
stories.take: Critics call Fielder and Oppenheim's Holmes documentary 'You Can See Everything' a bona-fide breakthrough, filmed over ~30 days before she reported to prison • The crew lived with Holmes, her partner and their kids — and the film keeps its subject deliberately unknowable • Sunday-edition conversation with critics Alyssa Wilkinson and Jason Zinoman

stories.title: AI is dividing the math world in two
stories.take: OpenAI's internal models solved long-standing open math problems, including Millennium Prize–level work — mathematicians describe sleeplessness and career anxiety • OpenAI dumped ~400 results in 700+ preprints in one evening; three were retracted for sign errors • The clash: Silicon Valley speed vs. academic norms of credit and process — and OpenAI refused a requested pause on testing frontier models against open problems

stories.title: Why The Tech Selloff Just Reversed Course
stories.take: The answer: AI-exposed stocks were 'dead money' for six months with compressed multiples, so semiconductors and industrials became attractive entry points • Credit fears around CoreWeave and neo-cloud debt were overblown and largely priced in — hyperscalers can self-finance • The real bubble risk may be private markets (Anthropic, OpenAI), not public tech • Ahead: Anthropic IPO clarity is a key catalyst

stories.title: Why Dems see opportunity in Alaska
stories.take: The answer: Trump's popularity in Alaska has dropped sharply since 2024, leaving Republican incumbents exposed • Ranked-choice voting and open primaries force candidates to the center, helping Mary Peltola (Senate) and Jonathan 'JKT' Christ Tompkins (governor) • Three Republicans are splitting the governor's vote while affordability crises hammer off-road communities

stories.title: US Banks Post Mixed Earnings Results
stories.take: The mixed verdict: equity trading carried the big banks while fixed-income slowed — except Citi, whose FICC revenue was its highest in at least a decade • JPMorgan raised next year's net interest income guidance above consensus on loan and deposit growth • Wells Fargo is regaining trading share now that the asset cap is gone, but commercial lending softened • Also: Domino's missed as lower-income customers cut back, and LVMH grew just 1% as China dragged

stories.title: Earnings Special: SpaceX Profit Beats Estimates on Big Jump in AI Revenue
stories.take: SpaceX crushed Q3: revenue $14.58B vs. $12.87B expected, net income $4.4B vs. $1.8B expected, EPS $0.35 vs. $0.15 • Starlink showed economies of scale as connectivity revenue grew • AI was the other profit driver, with capex of $19.6B in line with estimates

stories.title: GM Slides as CEO Barra Warns of ‘Intensifying’ Challenges
stories.take: GM raised its full-year forecast and announced a $20B buyback, yet shares fell 5–6% after Barra warned of 'intensifying' headwinds • New-vehicle prices now average over $50,000, squeezing buyers and dealers • GM's EV-only strategy has lost share to Toyota and Hyundai, and losing the $7,500 tax credit hurts more • Also in the episode: Salesforce's ~$5.7B Braze deal signals a return to serial M&A
